data.name: AION 4116-equivalent 16Kx1 NMOS DRAM

specification.refresh: Controller refreshes all 128 rows including hidden pages. Retention interval, refresh scheduling and speed grade require silicon qualification.
specification.package: 16-pin DIP target; qualified ordering code pending
specification.qualification_status: Accepted design baseline; AION manufacture and 4116 electrical compatibility require qualification, not a purchased supplier quote.

manufacturing_planning.status: Planning estimate at 3 micron, not layout-derived. Ordinary DRAM still requires capacitor, sense-amplifier, retention, refresh and speed qualification; no custom serial-output register.

manufacturing_requirements: Develop and qualify the ordinary DRAM cell/capacitor, sense amplifiers, retention, refresh and required speed grade before June 1978 launch.
Release 4116-compatible pinout, package, rails, timing, power, wafer probe and final test. AION is the manufacturing source; compatibility and speed require qualification.

second_source.qualification_status: Alternate-story staged release; exact per-part date and approved ordering code unresolved.
second_source.transfer: AION delivers process-compatible mask sets, reference silicon, manufacturing know-how, tests and qualification support.
second_source.procurement: AION remains launch source. No substitution before per-part electrical/reliability qualification.
